correctness.rationale: Using Hansen–Jaworski prescribed-degree cyclic-set counting, the tail P(C≥k) is e_k(d)/C(n,k), with k=n treated separately. Factoring ∏(1+d_i z) shows e_k(d′)−e_k(d)=(a−b−1)e_{k−2}(q). Newton inequalities for nonnegative residual q make A_j=e_j(q)/C(n,j+2) strictly log-concave on positive support, so its adjacent differences change sign once; TV is their largest cumulative shift. The cycle-count kernel K(k,l)=unsigned Stirling(k,l)/k! is TP2 through log-concavity of permutation cycle polynomials and its birth recurrence; it preserves one-crossing signed measures and contracts TV. For integer units, e_j(q)≤C(t,j), equality for all 0/1 residual profiles, and adjacent binomial ratio determines optimizer. Independent exhaustive mapping enumeration n=2..5 verified prescribed-degree tails and exact n=5 likelihood-ratio failure.
